review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197403 (2026-10-15T10:45:47Z), exhaustive RoleGranted/RoleRevoked/RoleAdminChanged replay from proxy creation block 23038326 contains four grants and no revocations or admin changes. Pinned hasRole and eth_getCode calls confirm two default-admin EOAs (0x407374be435ed278fca44be695d32f0230fe46e3, 0x5c943b2b881af70af571098a228d92cbcc2b5ba2) and two delegated MINTER_ROLE EOAs (0x7ba63cdc16abfbe4838eee04aff4150749a21bd8, 0xb99123ccab3e0110742cede9271953c6803947d4). The EIP-1967 implementation slot still resolves to 0x37686928ddf77be20fc4199f03f0638d90d9907e. Verified source establishes immediate UUPS replacement, uncapped minting and default-admin inheritance of all roles. Pinned RPC: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com. Organizational ownership, human independence and MPC/HSM/signing policies of these exact keys remain unattested; investor-wallet backup disclosures do not identify privileged-key custody. Primary documents reopened on 2026-10-15 establish a two-leg whole-fund reconciliation: the September 14 prospectus, Schedule 6 printed pages 131-132, requires at-least-daily transaction-triggered matching of the complete direct-shareholder register and blockchain Tokens, with independent Manager verification using per-custody-account reports. Annual audited reports are due within four months of December 31 and semi-annual reports within two months of June 30. KPMG's April 29, 2026 opinion covers the USD sub-fund's all-class assets and liabilities at December 31, 2025. The June 30, 2026 unaudited report published August 28 enumerates USD classes A/B/F/I and Listed Class, and reports USD 603,917,339 assets = USD 552,517 nonshare liabilities + USD 603,364,822 net assets attributable to shareholders. The daily token/register identity joined to recurring same-fund all-class financial accounts supports periodic reconciliation, not continuous assurance or a current exact token-to-reserve proof. Nominee end-client allocations are not visible to the fund; no separately issued bridge/wrapper population is established or covered. The current SFC OFC register names ChinaAMC Digital OFC BVQ025 and the public USD sub-fund BWG918, authorised July 2, 2025. SFO section 104 and SFC circular 26EC22 impose ongoing product, operational and ownership-record obligations on this issuing fund and its product provider, supporting prudential supervision without relying on custodian regulation or implying SFC endorsement, guaranteed backing or on-chain mint restrictions.
